LESSON: BELIEF IN QADAR

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Pillars of Iman
Topic 3.2: Belief in Qadar

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Belief in Qadar
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why should Muslims believe in Qadar and Qadha?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. describe the effects of believing in Qadar and Qadha as a pillar of Iman
2. appreciate belief in Qadar and Qadha to accept the Will of Allah

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: describe the effects of believing in Qadar and Qadha as a pillar of Iman

Teach
• Today’s focus: describe the effects of believing in Qadar and Qadha as a pillar of Iman.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “describe the effects of believing in Qadar and Qadha as a pillar of Iman” using a school example.
• Model B for “describe the effects of believing in Qadar and Qadha as a pillar of Iman” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "describe the effects of believing in Qadar and Qadha as a pillar of Iman" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 2: appreciate belief in Qadar and Qadha to accept the Will of Allah

Teach
• Today’s focus: appreciate belief in Qadar and Qadha to accept the Will of Allah.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “appreciate belief in Qadar and Qadha to accept the Will of Allah” using a school example.
• Model B for “appreciate belief in Qadar and Qadha to accept the Will of Allah” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "appreciate belief in Qadar and Qadha to accept the Will of Allah" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: describe the effects of believing in Qadar and Qadha as a pillar of Iman
• Model 2: appreciate belief in Qadar and Qadha to accept the Will of Allah

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: describe the effects of believing in Qadar and Qadha as a pillar of Iman
2. Practise: appreciate belief in Qadar and Qadha to accept the Will of Allah

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Belief in Qadar.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why should Muslims believe in Qadar and Qadha?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• describe the effects of believing in Qadar and Qadha as a pillar of Iman
• appreciate belief in Qadar and Qadha to accept the Will of Allah

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
